_comment: Versioned personal-install routing map (ADR-0098, issue #175). Maps a changed or edited file PATH to the skills the edit-gate marks REQUIRED for the task. A skill the router requires cannot be marked not-applicable without an operator waiver. This is the shipped default for a per-machine install; a repo may override it with its own. Globs: ** spans directories, * and ? do not cross '/'. Tune to your stack. The example routing map under judge-arch/assets/example maps to ARTIFACTS for the PR routing gate; this one maps to SKILLS for the edit-time gate.

rules.description: A schema or migration is a decision, a deployment risk, and often touches stored (possibly personal) data.
Auth, sessions, access control, secrets, crypto, or anything handling untrusted input must be threat-modeled.
A user-facing change must carry accessibility, cross-browser/device, and usability verdicts.
Production source should not change without tests and enumerated behavior moving with it.
A new service or endpoint must prove the team will know when it breaks.
A change to tests must prove the check it adds can actually detect, not just pass.
Editing an architecture decision record is itself an architectural decision.
